title: Exclusive Fishery Zone Regulation of Fishing Amendment Act 1993

sections.shortTitle: Exclusive Fishery Zone Regulation of Fishing Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1993
ACT V OF 1993
EXCLUSIVE FISHERY
ZONE (REGULATION OF FISHING) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to
amend the Exclusive Fishery Zone (Regulation of Fishing) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th March, 1993]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 20th March, 1993, and
is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Exclusive Fishery Zone
(Regulation of Fishing) (Amendment) Act, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Exclusive Fishery Zone Regulation of Fishing Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Amendment of section 9, Act XXXII of 1975

ACT V OF 1993
ACT V OF 1993
EXCLUSIVE FISHERY
ZONE (REGULATION OF FISHING) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to
amend the Exclusive Fishery Zone (Regulation of Fishing) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th March, 1993]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 20th March, 1993, and
is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 9, Act
XXXII of 1975:------In the Exclusive Fishery Zone (Regulation of Fishing)
Act, 1975 (XXXII of 1975), in section 9; -
(a) in the marginal heading,
after the word "penalty", the words "and procedure" shall
be added; and
(b) after subsection (4), the
following new subsections shall be added, namely:--
"(5) No Court inferior to
that of a Magistrate of the first class shall try any offence punishable under
this Act.
(6) Notwithstanding anything
contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898) it shall be
lawful for any Magistrate of the first class specially empowered by the
Provincial Government in this behalf to pass any sentence authorised by this
Act or by any of the laws extended under this Act:"
